Every parameter is a row of the data list's MIDI parameter change tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Parameter change: F0 43 1n 7F 00 <address> <data> F7, n the device number (the deviceId variable is 1n, 10H for device number 1); bulk dumps are asked for with 2n and answered with 0n, both taken as device number 1.
No identity check: the data list prints the identity request as received only, and no reply.

Parameter changes at 40-42 (Normal Voice) and 46-47 (Drum Voice) edit the voice in the Voice mode's edit buffer; Pull asks for each edit buffer the Bulk Control table names, whichever mode the instrument is in.
The Plug-in Voice (4C) and the Plug-in Parts edit what a PLG board installed in the slot holds; without one their messages go unanswered.
Not asked for, holding no parameter laid out here: Plug-in Board Native System.

Addresses misprinted in the data list, taken from where it prints them otherwise (a row's from the rows either side, a block's from another list): bulk dump block Plug-in 3 Part printed 37 44 00, taken as the last of the series from PLUG-IN PART Plug-in 1 Part (37 60 00), at 37 62 00.
Rows the data list prints without an address, taken as the row's before them past its size: MULTI COMMON: EQ Shape 2 (36 10 07).
